subject: Credit Rating- Revision
detail: PVR INOX Limited has informed the Exchange that Crisil Ratings Limited has revised the outlook on the long-term bank facilities and non-convertible debentures (NCDs) of the Company to Positive from Stable while reaffirming the rating at Crisil AA . The rating on the short-term bank facilities and commercial paper programme has been reaffirmed at Crisil A1+ .

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
detail: PVR INOX Limited has informed the Exchange that Company representatives participated in the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum 2026, organized by CLSA Securities, on November 17, 2026 in Mumbai, India. It was an in-person conference.
